content.text: ModeShape’s
Name
needs a localName and URI, as the trace suggests. With the provided SPARQL update statement, localName is blank for
http://example.org/
. (It should’ve been
http://example.org/title/

“ or something, I believe). This is enforced at many different points in ModeShape, and wherever this is checked (using the utility CheckArg), an exception gets thrown, and, perhaps more problematically, returned as a String.
For example, see
AbstractJcrNode

. The toString() catches the generic Exception, and returns the exception message as a String (not sure why ModeShape chose to do this).This is problematic if we log the value using something like FedoraResource.toString().
Options:
Perhaps the resolution would be to try to see if some sort of logging could be done in F4 upon initial PATCH. Alternatively, the runtime exception could also be caught in
PropertiesRdfContext

, although this would be ModeShape dependent behavior and I wouldn’t be surprised if patches would be needed in other F4 code as well. Or, perhaps just rely on users knowing better (that is know when an update is “dodgy”).
Ideally, we could return a 4xx status code on the initial PATCH.
In the absence of that possibility, we should at least enable the deletion of the resource after the fact.

Just a note on the latest comment: Deletion doesn't seem to be technically possible once a "dodgy" resource has made its way in (ModeShape still wants a localName when javax.jcr.Item#remove() is invoked), so validating the initial HTTP request is likely the only approach (and the one that I'm going to try).
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/811
When manually executing the steps in the following issue:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/issues/752
I get the following unexpected error:
https://gist.github.com/awoods/aee217a5929bd2c81de0
Instead, I would expect a 400 BadRequest response, and no stacktrace thrown to the client.
Added a commit to PR to address the comments.
PR updated after last PR review comments.
Resolved with:

, An integration test on migration-utils revealed that PR-811 introduced an error:
https://github.com/osmandin/fcrepo4/pull/5
PR-811 has been reverted from the master branch:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/50a04b588bc4369af9ef12a5be4a6073d665344d
Merged your PR and created (updated branch) PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/817
The invalid analog of the statement in the awoods PR passes through so the PR 817 should not be merged until more changes are made in the logic.
PR updated and ready for review testing.
PR-817 merged with master branch.
The issue detailed below has been confirmed:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/issues/752
This task is to investigate and resolve the issue.

This is enforced at many different points in ModeShape, and wherever this is checked (using the utility CheckArg), an exception gets thrown, and, perhaps more problematically, returned as a String.
